text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is about to begin!
The Umamusume chosen by the fans
will engage in a fierce battle here at Hanshin Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: All eyes are on the "Empress" Air Grooveand the "Runner from Another Dimension" Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It seems the fans are also waiting with bated breath for this fierce battle...!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Between Air Groove and Silence Suzuka, I wonder who will win...?

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
No matter who wins, it's gonna be an incredible race...!
I can't wait~!
As Air Groove headed toward the track—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—She's in even better shape than in the last mock race...
What a monster.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well then—
I'll be going on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Right, I can't afford to lose.
There is no way... I can ever lose!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Otherwise, I... This time, Suzuka's running will――――)
